Fmc Corp. Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2019. FMC Corp. announced earnings results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2019. For the third quarter, the company announced sales was USD 1,014.3 million compared to USD 923.6 million a year ago. Net income was USD 90.4 million compared to USD 72.8 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share from continuing operations was USD 0.85 compared to USD 0.36 a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 0.69 compared to USD 0.54 a year ago. For the nine months, sales was USD 3,412.5 million compared to USD 3,185.9 million a year ago. Net income was USD 480.6 million compared to USD 469.7 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share from continuing operations was USD 3.88 compared to USD 2.76 a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 3.66 compared to USD 3.47 a year ago. Diluted earnings per share from continuing operations was USD 3.85 compared to USD 2.74 a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 3.63 compared to USD 3.45 a year ago.
